description: the size of the bitmap used when exporting plot images to certain formats including Postscript, PDF, and SVG. The value assigned at install is 1650 x 1238. This values is saved and restored with the project, and stored in the registry and program shutdown.
notes: Plot-global: takes no plot name (not part of the per-plot keyword set).
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on the PFC3D 6.00 and 9.8 GUIs (syntax grade): accepted on both GUIs.
